articles.title: Hindustan Copper shares in focus as government opens 3% OFS at 10% discount to market price
articles.content: The government has announced its intention to divest a 3% holding in Hindustan Copper through an offer for sale, commencing for non-retail investors on August 25, with retail options shortly thereafter. The share floor price is pegged at Rs 514, below the closing value. If the offer is met with high demand, an extra 3% may be available.

articles.title: Bitcoin tops $80,000 for the first time since mid-May
articles.content: Bitcoin climbed above $80,000 for the first time since mid-May, extending a 23% weekly rally, its biggest in about three years. The surge reflects renewed optimism around crypto markets amid a combination of bullish signals and the liquidation of billions of dollars in leveraged bets. Despite the recovery, Bitcoin remains well below its October peak of around $126,000.

articles.title: Closing Auction System braces for its first monthly expiry test
articles.content: India’s derivatives market is set for its first monthly expiry under the new auction-based closing price system, marking a crucial test for the mechanism after concerns over sharp price swings and alleged manipulation. Introduced on August 3, the system has so far handled regular sessions and a weekly expiry. Tuesday’s monthly expiry will bring stock futures and options into play.

articles.title: Dollar struggles for traction as markets weigh Iran sanctions, Treasury buybacks
articles.content: On Tuesday, the U.S. dollar showed weakness against key currencies as investors reacted to new sanctions on Iran and attempts to reduce Treasury yields. The euro and pound both saw minor increases, approaching their recent highs. Additionally, Bitcoin enjoyed a notable weekly surge, bolstering its upward trajectory. Market watchers are eager for insights from Federal Reserve Chair Warsh's upcoming address regarding potential policy shifts.

articles.title: Gold touches highest level since mid-May as buying momentum builds
articles.content: Gold prices experienced an uptick on Tuesday, fueled by news of Treasury buybacks. Citi has upgraded its gold price projections, suggesting a likely easing of geopolitical tensions and a decline in real interest rates.

articles.title: Sensex logs worst two-year return trend since 2012
articles.content: Indian stock markets have disappointed investors with negative returns over two years.  The Sensex has shown its worst two-year performance since 2012. articles.title: Oil prices steady as investors weigh impact of expanded US sanctions against Iran
articles.content: On Tuesday, oil prices found stability following a notable decline on Monday. Investors are currently evaluating newly imposed U.S. sanctions that aim to target Iran's economy without resorting to military force. An incident involving an oil tanker near Oman has raised concerns about shipping safety. Additionally, the U.S. has reported a significant decrease in its strategic oil reserves, marking a historical low.
